title: One Hour Jet Ski Rental in Murrells Inlet SC
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Rent a jet ski in Murrells Inlet and embrace the thrill of open water adventure. Perfect for those seeking a self-guided experience, this rental allows you to explore the stunning coastline at your leisure. With a maximum of two people or 350 pounds per jet ski, you can either drive solo or take a passenger along for the ride. Safety instructions and an orientation are provided before you head out on the water, with a navigation ranger accompanying you through the inlet into the ocean, conditions permitting. Once in the ocean, you'll be free to play, explore and most importantly, have fun. Our experienced crew will then lead you back to the dock at the end of your trip.

- Drive solo or share the adventure with a passenger
- Safety briefing and guidance included for peace of mind
- Drivers must be 18+ with valid ID
- Each ticket is for one jet ski, up to two people
